notes: Workable areas inside a rideshare market, as county FIPS codes (US Census). Uber and Lyft do not publish these; they come from the driver's own app (Uber Driver > Preferences > Preferred areas). Drivers confirm or change them in Home Base onboarding (Workable area). Markets not listed default to their home-state counties within the working radius.

baltimore.source: Uber Driver app, Preferences > 'Choose your preferred areas', Baltimore market (screenshot shared by the owner, Oct 26 2026): Baltimore City and County, Harford (Bel Air), Howard, Anne Arundel, Carroll, Frederick and Washington County, Calvert, Charles and St. Mary's. Montgomery and Prince George's belong to the Washington market; Cecil and the Eastern Shore are outside it. County edges were read from the map, so confirm in the app.

washington-dc.source: No preferred-area screenshot yet; defaults to DC, Maryland and Virginia counties within the working radius until the driver confirms their areas.
